pr_title: Fix being able to select incompatible freemods
pr_body:
Closes https://github.com/ppy/osu/issues/11854

Needs server-side validation (see https://github.com/ppy/osu-web/issues/7243), but this disables local selection.

(I thought I already had these changes in the original PR...)
pr_comments:
While I was working at fixing this issue, I noticed two side issues, which this PR doesn't seem to have addressed as well:
  1. The checkbox doesn't get in a correct state after filtering out some free mods in a section, this is due to the `ModButtonsStateChanged` method not being called after new buttons are loaded from changes to `IsValidMod`:
  
  https://user-images.githubusercontent.com/22781491/108668106-8e643300-74eb-11eb-8fa8-5e18acadb6f3.mov
  
  2. The performance overhead from selecting a required mod while having your free mods list filled up, as I stated in the linked issue. Not much of an expert on this kind of stuff, but with using `dotTrace` it seems to partly come from `ModDisplay` clearing and reloading all icons of the free mods. Also somewhat comes from the `ModSettingsContainer` reloading all the controls on any changes to the mods list, which I'm preparing a PR for that later today.

Fixed the checkbox state. I think performance is a separate issue altogether, and probably more comes down to how `ModSelectOverlay` clears/adds new buttons rather than how it clears/adds the controls (if the buttons change, the controls need to).
That's much harder to fix because currently the sections rely on loading all mods at once time rather than inserting buttons.

issue_context.title: Freemod allows for invalid mod configurations
issue_context.body:
**Describe the bug:** 
Using a combinaison of freemod and required mods, you can enable mods that aren't supposed to be enabled at the same time
**Screenshots or videos showing encountered issue:** 

https://user-images.githubusercontent.com/24226538/108612817-04687d00-73ba-11eb-85c3-21469a7a71a1.mp4

**osu!lazer version:** 
2021.220.0
**Logs:**
[runtime.log](https://github.com/ppy/osu/files/6016952/runtime.log)
[network.log](https://github.com/ppy/osu/files/6016953/network.log)
comments: Yeah, I was planning on fixing this one but I ran into a performance overhead from making the free mods overlay updating itself with the selected required mods to not show incompatible ones. Will see if I can reduce the overhead and PR my changes.

review_comments:
This doesn't catch all cases. Multi mods are one that I have on my mind in particular; for example, you can select Perfect as a required mod and add Sudden Death as a free mod, which doesn't make much sense. Worse yet, there are crashing cases - e.g. in mania, selecting Hidden as required and Fade In as free results in a crash with the following stack trace:

```
[runtime] 2021-02-22 21:18:20 [error]: System.InvalidCastException: Unable to cast object of type 'osu.Framework.Graphics.Containers.BufferedContainer' to type 'osu.Framework.Graphics.Containers.Container'.
[runtime] 2021-02-22 21:18:20 [error]: at osu.Game.Rulesets.Mania.Mods.ManiaModHidden.ApplyToDrawableRuleset(DrawableRuleset`1 drawableRuleset) in /home/dachb/Dokumenty/opensource/osu/osu.Game.Rulesets.Mania/Mods/ManiaModHidden.cs:line 33
[runtime] 2021-02-22 21:18:20 [error]: at osu.Game.Rulesets.UI.DrawableRuleset`1.applyRulesetMods(IReadOnlyList`1 mods, OsuConfigManager config) in /home/dachb/Dokumenty/opensource/osu/osu.Game/Rulesets/UI/DrawableRuleset.cs:line 349
```

Not sure whether this should be handled in this check, or at the level of incompatibility rules, so this might not be in scope of this pull, but I figured I'd better point this out.
